_readme: EVERY VALUE HERE IS ONE PROARC PUBLISHES ABOUT ITSELF (08-contact-data.md §1).
A third-party directory's account of ProArc is a CANDIDATE, and a candidate never
ships — it goes on the letter. The street address the 2GIS and FOB listings agree
on is therefore absent from this file by decision, not by oversight.
THE TWO GATES ARE THE TWO NULLS. There is no separate open/closed flag, because a
flag and a value can contradict each other and one of them would then be a lie:
street      null  -> X14 is open. The row is labelled Post and carries the PO
Box alone. Give this file a street and the row becomes
Address, in that order, with the PO Box beneath it.
hours.days  null  -> X15 is open. The Hours row is not rendered at all.
Give this file a day range and the row arrives.
NO BRACKETED DUMMY MAY EVER BE WRITTEN HERE. build/lib/contact.js throws on a
square bracket in any value. Brackets are a board and spec device (08-contact-data
§5); /careers shipped "[ Job Title ]" live to the public, and that is the fault
this build removes rather than repeats. A gate that is open renders NOTHING —
an absence is honest where a placeholder is not.
The tel: href is NOT authored. It is derived from phone by the build so the dialled
number and the printed number cannot drift apart.

published.poBox: P.O. Box 13003, Ajman, United Arab Emirates
